account.name: Basic Business Checking
account.fee_waiver: No monthly maintenance fee

tiers.condition: Per statement cycle with a $3,000+ average daily balance, earnable up to 4 times across the first 5 statement cycles

offers.notes: Low capital, low bonus, no DD — the floor case for the min_bonus_threshold filter.

account.name: Business Premium Savings + Basic Business Checking
account.fee_waiver: No monthly maintenance fee

tiers.condition: Per qualifying statement cycle: deposit $1,000+ via ACH/check/wire into checking, make 2+ debit purchases of $50+, keep $1,500+ average daily balance in checking and $50,000+ in Business Premium Savings

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: Deposits may be ACH, check or wire — not restricted to payroll direct deposit.

clawback.notes: $50 early closure fee if closed within 180 days. Both accounts must be opened through a single bundled application. The $100 is earnable in up to 6 of the first 7 statement cycles.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: New customers only; cannot have qualified for any Axos promotion in the 12 months prior to opening.

offers.notes: Repeating tier: $100 per qualifying statement cycle, up to 6 of the first 7 cycles = $600. bonus.amount is the full $600 but the timeline is ~6 months, not one cycle.

account.name: Smart Advantage Checking
account.fee_waiver: Smart Advantage Checking has no monthly maintenance fee

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: Must be regular income from an employer or similar third party (salary, paycheck, pension, Social Security or government benefits) deposited electronically.

clawback.notes: Bonus is deposited approximately 100 days after account opening. Accounts with a zero balance may be closed. One bonus per eligible customer.

account.name: 360 Checking
account.fee_waiver: No monthly fees or minimums

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: Qualifying deposits are periodic ACH or RTP payments from an employer or outside entity. Wires and internal Capital One transfers are excluded.

clawback.notes: Account must be open and in good standing at deposit time; bonus expected within ~135 days of opening (75-day qualifying period plus up to 60 days processing).

eligibility.cooldown_notes: Ineligible if you had an open 360 Checking, Simply Checking or Total Control Checking account as primary or secondary holder on or after 2024-01-01.

offers.notes: No published deadline — an evergreen offer. min_amount_each ($500) AND count (2) both bind here, which is the cleanest fit for a biweekly earner in the whole set.

account.name: 360 Performance Savings
account.fee_waiver: No monthly fees

tiers.condition: Deposit $20,000-$49,999.99 within 15 days of account opening and hold 90 days
Deposit $50,000-$99,999.99 within 15 days of account opening and hold 90 days
Deposit $100,000+ within 15 days of account opening and hold 90 days

clawback.notes: Balance must be held 90 days after the close of the 15-day funding window; no early closure penalty reported.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: Ineligible if you held a 360 Performance Savings, 360 Savings, 360 Money Market, Savings Now or Confidence Savings account as primary or secondary holder on or after 2024-01-01.

offers.notes: Pure capital play, no DD. The planner gates this on profile.max_liquid_capital — the lowest tier already needs $20,000.

account.name: Business Complete Banking
account.fee_waiver: Waived with any of: $2,000 minimum daily balance; $2,000 in monthly purchases on a linked Chase Ink card; $2,000 in Chase QuickAccept deposits; linked Chase Private Client Checking; qualifying military status

tiers.condition: Deposit $2,000+ in new money within 30 days and hold it 60 days from enrollment, plus 5 qualifying transactions within 90 days
Deposit $10,000+ in new money within 30 days and hold it 60 days from enrollment, plus 5 qualifying transactions within 90 days

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: No direct deposit required. Qualifying transactions are debit purchases, QuickAccept deposits, QuickDeposit, ACH credits, wires and Chase Online Bill Pay. ACH debits, Zelle and credit card transfers are excluded.

clawback.notes: Account must stay open roughly 6 months or the bonus is forfeited. Chase reportedly withholds an estimated-tax amount from the bonus.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: One bonus per customer per two-year period. Existing Chase business checking customers excluded, as are accounts closed within the prior 3 years with a negative balance.

offers.notes: Business offer — excluded unless profile.allow_business_accounts is true.

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: No direct deposit required; this is a pure balance-park offer.

clawback.notes: Deposit $300,000+ within 60 days of enrollment and maintain at least a $300,000 balance for 180 days from enrollment.

offers.notes: Capital-intensive: $300k parked for 6 months. Included to prove the schema handles balance-only offers with no DD leg.

account.name: Chase Savings
account.fee_waiver: Waived with a $300 minimum daily balance; $25+ in monthly automatic transfers from a linked Chase checking account; a linked Chase Premier Plus/Sapphire checking account; or primary owner under 18

clawback.notes: Deposit $15,000+ in new money within 30 days of coupon enrollment and maintain a $15,000 balance for 90 days from enrollment. The hold runs from enrollment, not from bonus payment.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: One new-savings bonus every two years from the last enrollment date. Ineligible if you closed a Chase savings account within 90 days or closed one with a negative balance in the last 3 years.

offers.notes: TARGETED offer — savings leg of a combined $900 checking + savings promotion. Not publicly available to everyone; no chase.com page could be retrieved.

account.name: Total Checking
account.fee_waiver: $0 with any one of: $500+ in total qualifying electronic deposits per month; $1,500+ beginning-day balance; $5,000+ average beginning-day balance across linked qualifying accounts; or a linked qualifying Chase checking account

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: Qualifying electronic deposits: payroll, pension, government benefit and other ACH credits. Enrollment coupon is applied automatically when applying from the offer page.

clawback.notes: Enrolled account must not be closed or restricted at the time of payout. No explicit post-bonus hold period stated on the offer page.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: Also ineligible if you closed a Chase checking account within 90 days, or closed one with a negative balance in the last 3 years.

offers.notes: window_starts is coupon_enrollment, not account_open: the 90-day clock runs from when the coupon is enrolled.

account.name: Citi Checking
account.fee_waiver: Waived when the account receives $250+ per month in qualifying Enhanced Direct Deposits

tiers.condition: $3,000+ in Enhanced Direct Deposits within 90 days of account opening
$5,000+ in Enhanced Direct Deposits within 90 days; limited-market availability

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: Enhanced Direct Deposits are broader than typical: payroll, pension, Social Security and government benefits, plus Zelle and ACH-based P2P payments (Venmo, PayPal) reportedly qualify.

clawback.notes: No early-closure fee reported. The balance tiers require holding the deposited balance for a period after funding rather than a post-bonus hold.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: Requires not having owned a Citi checking account in the last 365 days.

offers.notes: Citi renders its bonus terms dynamically, so amounts and deadline are aggregator-sourced. Sources conflict on the deadline (DoC says 2026-10-22, bankbonus.com says 2026-10-26). The $325 tier is nationwide; the $475 tier is limited-market (reported NY, CT, MD, VA, DC, CA, NV, NJ and select FL/IL) — headline is the max achievable, so verify market eligibility before planning on $475. The balance-funded path is filed separately as citi-checking-balance-1500-2026: same account, different requirement path, so it gets its own offer file.

account.name: Citi Checking
account.fee_waiver: Waived when the account receives $250+ per month in qualifying Enhanced Direct Deposits

tiers.condition: Deposit $30,000+ in new-to-Citi funds and hold for the required period (no direct deposit required)
Deposit $200,000+ in new-to-Citi funds and hold for the required period (no direct deposit required)

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: No direct deposit on this path — the bonus is funded by new-to-Citi balances.

clawback.notes: No early-closure fee reported. The balance tiers require holding the deposited balance for a period after funding rather than a post-bonus hold.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: Requires not having owned a Citi checking account in the last 365 days.

offers.notes: Balance-funded path for the same Citi Checking account. Split out from citi-checking-475-2026 because the validator caught the real modelling rule: one offer file = one requirement path. Mixing a $3,000-in-DDs tier and a $200,000-balance tier in one file makes bonus.amount meaningless and makes the planner's feasibility check wrong for both.

account.name: Momentum Checking
account.fee_waiver: Momentum Checking has no monthly service fee

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: Qualifying direct deposits are payroll, Social Security, pension and government benefits.

clawback.notes: Bonus paid within 10 business days of completing the qualifying activity; account must remain open for 90 days.

offers.notes: Low bar for a biweekly earner: one $500+ paycheck inside 90 days clears it.

account.name: FourLeaf Free Checking
account.fee_waiver: Free Checking — no monthly fee

tiers.condition: Receive a qualifying direct deposit of $500+ within 90 days of account opening and make 10 point-of-sale debit card transactions
At the 12-month anniversary, having maintained monthly recurring direct deposits of $500+ and 10 POS debit transactions per month
At the 24-month anniversary, having maintained monthly recurring direct deposits of $500+ and 10 POS debit transactions per month

clawback.notes: Account must remain open and in good standing through each bonus deposit date; the anniversary tiers require sustained monthly DD and debit activity for up to 24 months.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: No existing FourLeaf checking account as primary holder; no prior FourLeaf new-checking bonus; one bonus per member.

offers.notes: Tiers here are ADDITIVE, not alternative: $350 up front plus $100 at each of the 12- and 24-month anniversaries = $550 over two years. This is the edge case that forced bonus.tier_mode into the schema — without it the planner would credit $550 against a 90-day timeline and rank this first by a mile. The planner scores the $350 near-term tier and surfaces the anniversary tiers as caveats.

account.name: Perks Checking / Platinum Perks Checking
account.fee_waiver: Perks ($10/mo): waived with $1,000+ in monthly deposits or $5,000 total relationship balance. Platinum Perks ($25/mo): waived with $25,000 total relationship balance

tiers.condition: Open Perks Checking and receive qualifying direct deposits totaling $500+ within 90 days of account opening
Open Platinum Perks Checking and make total new money deposits of at least $25,000 within 90 days (no direct deposit required)

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: P2P transfers (PayPal, Zelle, Venmo), Real-Time Payments and transfers from other Huntington accounts do not count.

clawback.notes: Account must remain open a minimum of 90 days.

offers.notes: The $600 tier is balance-driven, not DD-driven — the $400 Perks tier is the one a biweekly earner actually plans around.

account.name: Key Smart Checking / Key Select Checking
account.fee_waiver: Key Smart Checking has no monthly maintenance fee. Key Select is $25/mo, waived for the first 3 months and thereafter with $3,000+ in direct deposits or $15,000+ combined balances

tiers.condition: Open Key Smart Checking ($10 minimum opening deposit) and receive $2,000+ in qualifying direct deposits within 90 days
Open Key Select Checking ($50 minimum opening deposit) and receive $5,000+ in qualifying direct deposits within 90 days

clawback.notes: Account must remain open through bonus payout, up to 60 days after requirements are met.

offers.notes: Cooldown is unstated by every source found — planner treats unknown cooldown as a caveat, not a pass.

account.name: MyChoice Plus Checking
account.fee_waiver: MyChoice Plus: $14.95/mo, waived with a $2,500 average daily balance or $1,500+ in direct deposits per cycle. EZChoice Checking ($0/mo) also qualifies for the offer; MyWay Banking does not

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: Recurring electronic deposits of payroll, pension or Social Security. P2P and bank-to-bank transfers do not count.

clawback.notes: Aggregators report a $50 early closure fee within 180 days; this is not stated on the promo landing page.

offers.notes: One of only two offers in the set with a real clawback (180-day hold, $50 early close fee) — the safe-to-close date matters here.

account.name: Virtual Wallet with Performance Select
account.fee_waiver: Waived with a qualifying monthly direct deposit or qualifying relationship balances

tiers.condition: Open Virtual Wallet (base) and receive $500+ in qualifying direct deposits within the first 60 days
Open Virtual Wallet with Performance Select and receive $5,000+ in qualifying direct deposits within the first 60 days

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: Must be recurring direct deposits of paycheck, pension, Social Security or other regular income. Wires, P2P transfers, inter-account transfers and branch/ATM deposits do not count.

clawback.notes: Account must remain open to receive the bonus. Bonus is credited 60-90 days after all conditions are met.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: Two rules stack: ineligible with an existing PNC consumer checking account or one closed in the past 12 months, AND ineligible if you were primary signer on an account that received a PNC promotional premium in the past 24 months.

offers.notes: Deadline is imminent (10 days from first_seen) — a good test of the near-expiry warning path. payout_days_after_completion is null because the bank states a 60-90 day range, not a single figure.

account.name: LifeGreen Checking
account.fee_waiver: LifeGreen Checking: $8/mo with eStatements ($11 without). LifeGreen Preferred: $18/mo, waived with a $5,000 average monthly balance, $25,000 combined deposits, $25,000 qualifying loan balances, or a qualifying mortgage

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: Qualifying ACH direct deposits within 90 days. Registration for the offer is separate from account opening.

clawback.notes: $25 early closure fee if the account is closed within 180 days.

offers.notes: Two-date offer: register by 2026-12-31, open by 2027-01-31 — this is why enroll_by exists separately from deadline. A separate $50 referral bonus is also available.

account.name: SoFi Checking and Savings
account.fee_waiver: No account, overdraft, service or maintenance fees

tiers.condition: $1.00-$999.99 in eligible direct deposits during the 25-day evaluation period
$1,000.00-$4,999.99 in eligible direct deposits during the 25-day evaluation period
$5,000.00 or more in eligible direct deposits during the 25-day evaluation period

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: Eligible deposits are payroll, pension or government benefit ACH credits from an employer, payroll provider, benefits provider or government agency. Zelle, PayPal and Venmo transfers do not qualify. The 25-day clock starts at the first eligible deposit of $1+.

clawback.notes: Account must be in good standing at time of payment. No clawback or early-close fee stated.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: Existing SoFi members qualify only if they have never previously set up direct deposit with SoFi. Limit one bonus per member; on joint accounts only the primary holder's activity counts.

data_points.notes: Posted same day as employer payroll.

offers.notes: The hardest window in the dataset: $5,000 cumulative in 25 days. A biweekly earner gets at most 2 pay dates in 25 days, so this needs typical_dd_amount >= $2,500. Doctor of Credit reports the bonus is issued on Form 1099-MISC, not 1099-INT; SoFi's page does not state the form, so taxable_1099int is null.

account.name: TD Complete Checking / TD Beyond Checking
account.fee_waiver: TD Complete ($15/mo): waived with $500+ in direct deposits per cycle, a $500 minimum daily balance, or $5,000 combined balances. TD Beyond ($25/mo): waived with $5,000+ in direct deposits per cycle, a $2,500 minimum daily balance, or $25,000 combined balances

tiers.condition: Open TD Complete Checking and receive $500+ in qualifying direct deposits within 60 days of account opening
Open TD Beyond Checking and receive $2,500+ in qualifying direct deposits within 60 days of account opening

clawback.notes: Bonus is paid on or before 180 days after account opening; account must be open and in good standing at payout.

offers.notes: A separate $200 TD Signature Savings bonus (deposit $10,000 within 20 days, hold 90 more) can be stacked for up to $500 total.

account.name: Truist One Checking
account.fee_waiver: Six waiver paths including age under 25, age 62+, student status, $500+ in qualifying direct deposits, $500+ combined balance, or a linked Truist credit product

clawback.notes: Requires BOTH at least 2 qualifying direct deposits totaling $2,000+ AND at least 20 qualifying debit card purchases, both within 120 days of account opening. Bonus paid within 10 business days after verification.

offers.notes: The only offer requiring a large debit-transaction count alongside DDs — 20 purchases in 120 days is ~1 every 6 days.

account.name: Rewards Checking Plus
account.fee_waiver: No monthly maintenance fee

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: No direct deposit required, but the account must be funded and 3 debit purchases must settle.

clawback.notes: Requires applying for an Upgrade Card and, within 60 days, opening and funding Rewards Checking Plus plus 3 settled debit purchases. ATM transactions do not count. Both the card and the checking account must remain open and in good standing.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: Cannot have previously opened a checking account through Upgrade.

offers.notes: The only HARD-pull offer in the set — it must contend for a scarce max_hard_pulls_per_6mo slot, which is what makes the pacing constraint visible in the plan.

account.name: Smartly Checking
account.fee_waiver: Waived for the first two statement periods; thereafter with $1,500+ in monthly direct deposits, a $1,500 average balance, a Smartly Visa Signature card, Smart Rewards Gold+, military status, primary owner age 13-24 or 65+, or a linked small business account

tiers.condition: $2,000-$4,999.99 in qualifying direct deposits within 90 days of account opening
$5,000-$7,999.99 in qualifying direct deposits within 90 days of account opening
$8,000 or more in qualifying direct deposits within 90 days of account opening

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: Two or more qualifying direct deposits (payroll or government benefits via ACH). P2P payments do not qualify.

clawback.notes: No clawback or early-closure penalty stated on the offer page.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: Ineligible if you held a U.S. Bank consumer checking account in the last 12 months or received a U.S. Bank checking bonus in the last 12 months.

offers.notes: Also requires enrolling in the U.S. Bank mobile app or online banking within 90 days. Bonus is credited as adjusted interest and reported on 1099-INT. Offer may be unavailable outside the U.S. Bank footprint but no state list is published, so states_included is left null.

account.name: Everyday Checking
account.fee_waiver: Waived per fee period with $500+ in qualifying electronic deposits, a $1,500 minimum daily balance, $5,000+ in combined Wells Fargo deposit and investment balances, primary owner age 17-24, or qualifying military direct deposit

direct_deposit.qualifying_notes: Qualifying deposits include ACH direct deposits, RTP/FedNow instant payments, and electronic credits from third-party services over the Visa/Mastercard networks.

clawback.notes: Account must remain open through the date the bonus is deposited. Accounts with zero balances may be closed without notice.

eligibility.cooldown_notes: Ineligible if you received a Wells Fargo checking bonus in the past 12 months. Employees, non-resident aliens, foreign entities and Private Bank accounts excluded. Cannot be combined with other checking promotions.

offers.notes: Some aggregators advertise $400; the live Wells Fargo offer page confirms $325.
